summary: The P0 filed as HF-INTG-006-TICKETING is FIXED in the ticketing lane. Confirmed from source, not from the summary: claimWebhookEvent collapsed a 23505 into a bare boolean and the route answered {received: true, duplicate: true} on it, while ticket_stripe_webhook_events declared processed_at timestamptz not null default now() (20260821000000_reconcile_ticketing_foundation.sql:343), which the claim INSERT stamps — so the ledger had no field written at completion at all. The disposition is the resume-vs-acknowledge split INTG-006 recommended, implemented in the shape this repository already uses for app/api/photos/purchase/webhook/route.ts (claim, read the marker, resume or acknowledge, and CHECK the completion write). Migration 20260926130000_ticketing_webhook_completion_marker.sql adds a nullable completed_at, an attempts counter, and a partial index on the incomplete subset; no RLS or policy change. The duplicate is now resolved by the completion marker: completed acknowledges with zero side effects, claimed-but-not-completed RESUMES, and an unreadable marker or an unwritable completion fails closed with 500. The response gains an additive outcome field and never reports duplicate:true for work that did not occur.
